Dear [Mr Macmillan](../persons.html#939),
I enclose what [Mrs Blackburn](../persons.html#159) says in answer to my question about the drawings for the [Little Duke](../books.html#20) - Will you tell me what you think of the matter? I suppose she might improve some of the faces, but I think it is quite open to you to find some other designer. I shall send tomorrow another parcel of [the Trial](../books.html#53)
Yours faithfully
C.M.

Yonge

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
